speaker: narrator
text: A letter brought you to Vellmoor. Heavy paper, a fine old-fashioned hand. It is signed Anton Morosz, burgomaster.

speaker: narrator
text: It asks for hunters. Our dead do not stay in the ground, it says. Come quickly. Come before the snow.

speaker: narrator
text: This year the valley has buried more of its own than in the ten years before. It is All Hallows' Eve.

speaker: narrator
text: You come down the last hill at dusk. On the far ridge stands a castle, every window lit for the first time in years.

speaker: narrator
text: Behind you, the mist comes down over the road. It does not drift. It falls, like a lid. When it thins, the road is gone.

speaker: narrator
text: There is no way back. Ahead, at the crossroads, a lamp burns over the door of an inn. The Lantern and Bell.

speaker: narrator
text: Find the burgomaster's house. Keep his daughter safe till dawn. Then have your fortunes read.

speaker: narrator
text: Two new parishes open. Bring back Stefan's blade and the Lantern of Saint Ysolde.

speaker: narrator
text: The last parish opens. Find the Tome there, and learn the truth of him.

speaker: narrator
text: Carry the blade, the Lantern and the Tome to his gate. Climb, and destroy him.
